prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for specific kinds of changes, as no category yet has at least two tests that agree after noise correction.
Predictions were mostly too high in early rounds compared to measured, noise-corrected results.
Predictions in Round 3 were too low, underestimating winning changes such as sign-in hints and path selection copy.
Changes resulting in no clear effect must be treated as having no effect, even when noise-corrected estimates lean positive.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: +4.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, incentive: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +4.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.8%, median 3s / mean 567s

- home: 83.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Two Column Pick Friend Redesign: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a dynamic two-column layout separating preset styles from custom attribute options. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the funnel at 60.9% and a long median duration of 89s; support emails also report custom pet generation failures.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Check Screen: Adds a dedicated confirmation step after home intro to verify the pet is visible on desktop and explain basic click-drag placement. (why: Support received multiple complaints about pets not showing on desktop and users being confused on how to control or interact with their companion.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Pet Behavior Preview Flow: Adds an interactive behavior preview component to the waiting screen, allowing users to test pet animations while generation runs. (why: The home wait step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; engaging users during generation prevents drop-off before completion.)
3: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Desktop Controls Intro: Redesigns the home intro screen into a spotlight layout that highlights key interaction shortcuts like right-clicking to manage or hide the pet. (why: Support received emails regarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to pets post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Recovery Hint: Displays an explicit hint reassuring users that signing in with their existing account restores all previously adopted companions. (why: The top support complaint (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Time Remaining Counter: Enables time estimation displays and active progress indicators on the waiting screen during pet creation. (why: Home step waiting time has a high mean (2336s) and median (201s), causing users to abandon before finishing.)
6: [choose_path, incentive] Custom Creation Path Perk Banner: Adds a highlighted badge explaining the advantages of custom generation versus default companion presets. (why: The choose_path step median time is only 8s; setting expectations early helps users pick the path best suited for them.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Companion Origin Story Headline Update: Updates the story screen headline and button text to clearly introduce the desktop pet concept before path selection. (why: Mean time spent on the choose_path step is high (514s), indicating some users hesitate at the entry point of onboarding.)
8: [home, notification] Background Ready Desktop Sound Alert: Adds a sound alert toggle and ready notification setup on the waiting screen so users know when generation completes in the background. (why: Long wait times (median 201s) mean users minimize the app; notification options ensure they return to finish onboarding.)

scores.note: Adoption has highest drop (39.1%) and support reports failures; redesigns show moderate positive lift.
Adding new screens tends to increase drop-off, historically yielding negative lift (-3.3%).
New interactive flows require high effort and past test showed negligible effect (+0.3%).
Finish step has high drop-off (35.2%) and direct support complaints; inline redesign avoids extra screen penalty.
Top support issue (8 emails); sign-in hints have proven positive results across multiple tests.
Addresses high wait time duration; wait info toggles/indicators consistently deliver positive lift.
Choose_path has low drop-off; incentive banners previously showed minimal impact (+0.4%).
Low cost text update addressing hesitation; copy updates on path selection showed strong positive lift (+4.6%).
Helps re-engage users minimizing app during wait; notification changes show reliable moderate lift.
